sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00, looking to extend their impressive recent form. Sandbach are in exceptional shape with seven wins from their last ten games and currently top the table on 22 points, while Alsager Town arrive as one of the division's struggling sides with just four points from ten matches and a run of five consecutive losses before a recent win.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a challenging away trip to Dawley Town, hoping to keep pace with leaders Sandbach after their recent draw. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the table, have bounced back from their most recent defeat and travel to Eccleshall, who sit fifth but have lost their last game. Wolverhampton Casuals host Wednesfield Community in a mid-table clash, with the hosts looking to build on their recent win. Bilston Town, sixth and in good form with two consecutive wins, take on Foley Meir at home. Market Drayton Town visit in-form Allscott Heath seeking to reverse their recent loss, while Crewe host Allscott Heath in what could be a tight encounter given both sides' inconsistent recent records. Shawbury United entertain Barnton after a tough run of five consecutive defeats, while Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a basement-six clash between two sides struggling to find consistent wins. Brereton Social face Widnes Town, the division's bottom club with just two points from seven games.
